description: Fleet-wide Slurm job allocation and the GPU telemetry inside those jobs, from on-tray cgroup attribution joined to DCGM. Canonical owner of "jobs/trays/GPUs allocated right now".

options.content:
Validation & training runs — live job and GPU telemetry. Canonical owner of jobs / trays / GPUs allocated right now across the whole fleet. Job attribution comes from cgroup_info on each tray; GPU telemetry from DCGM on the same tray. Every count is followed by a table built from the identical selector, so the table's footer row count equals the number above it.

panels.title: Allocation right now  —  Slurm job steps seen by the on-tray cgroup exporter

panels.description: Distinct Slurm job IDs holding at least one tray at this instant. The table directly below lists exactly these jobs and prints its row count in the footer.
panels.title: Jobs running now

panels.description: DGX trays running at least one Slurm job step at this instant. The table directly below lists exactly these trays and prints its row count in the footer.
panels.title: Trays allocated now

panels.description: GPUs reporting DCGM telemetry inside a tray that currently holds a job step. The per-rack table directly below sums to this number — see its footer Total.

panels.description: Total DCGM board power drawn by the GPUs counted to the left. The per-rack table directly below sums to this number — see its footer Total.

panels.description: Built from the same cgroup_info selector as the 'Jobs running now' stat. One row per job ID; the footer Count equals that stat. 'Trays' is how many trays the job is holding.

defaults.noValue: No Slurm job step is running on any tray right now — the on-tray exporter only emits job series while a step is live. Use the window section below.

panels.description: Built from the same cgroup_info selector as the 'Trays allocated now' stat. One row per tray; the footer Count equals that stat. 'Job steps' above 1 means the tray is shared by more than one job.
panels.title: Trays allocated now — the exact trays behind the count above

panels.description: Same selectors as 'GPUs in allocated trays' and 'GPU power in allocated trays', broken out per rack. The footer shows the column totals, which equal those two stats exactly.
panels.title: By rack — these columns sum to the two stats above

panels.description: Same selector and same time range as the stat above. One row per job ID; the footer Count equals that stat.

defaults.noValue: No rows — nothing matches the count above.

panels.title: Jobs in this window — the exact jobs behind the count above

panels.description: Same selector and same time range as the stat above; the footer Count equals that stat. Each peak is the highest value any single GPU on that tray reached during the range.
panels.title: Trays in this window — the exact trays behind the count above, with peak telemetry

panels.description: The same two expressions as the 'GPU power in allocated trays' and 'Trays allocated now' stats, plotted across the range. The legend gives the last and the peak value of each.
panels.title: Allocated GPU power and tray count over time
The GPUs inside those runs  —  DCGM, scoped to allocated trays only

panels.description: GPUs held by a Slurm job step that are reporting zero SM utilisation right now — a rank that is stalled, waiting or never started. The table directly below names exactly these GPUs.
panels.title: Allocated GPUs at 0 % SM utilisation

panels.description: GPUs held by a Slurm job step with a non-zero XID code or a non-zero volatile ECC counter. The table directly below names exactly these GPUs and the fault each one carries.

targets.expr: count(label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"} > 0 and on(node) last_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"}[15m]), "fault", "XID", "", "") or label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_VOL_TOTAL{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"} > 0 and on(node) last_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"}[15m]), "fault", "ECC single-bit (volatile)", "", "") or label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_VOL_TOTAL{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"} > 0 and on(node) last_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"}[15m]), "fault", "ECC double-bit (volatile)", "", "")) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Allocated GPUs reporting an XID or volatile ECC fault

panels.description: The identical expression to the stat above, rendered one row per GPU; the footer Count equals that stat. An empty table means every allocated GPU is doing work.

defaults.noValue: No Slurm job step is running on any tray right now — the on-tray exporter only emits job series while a step is live. Use the window section below.

panels.description: The identical expression to the stat above, rendered one row per GPU and fault type; the footer Count equals that stat. For an XID row the value is the XID code (45 = preemptive cleanup after an earlier error, 94 = contained ECC error); for an ECC row it is the volatile error counter.
